KEY-1.name: BAD_NAME
KEY-1.description: Raised when a key is asked for under a word that cannot name one.

KEY-10.name: NO_SUCH_KEY
KEY-10.description: Raised when no active key holds the name a revoke gave.

KEY-11.name: MEMBERS_MAY_NOT_MINT
KEY-11.description: Raised when a household member asks to mint a key and the operator has not allowed members to.

KEY-12.name: CLAIM_NOT_OPEN
KEY-12.description: Raised when a key is asked to be collected with a claim that collects nothing.

KEY-13.name: UNLINKABLE
KEY-13.description: Raised when a key is asked to be minted as a claim and no address another machine reaches can go in its link.

KEY-2.name: NOT_A_SCOPE
KEY-2.description: Raised when a key is asked for with a scope that is none of the three.

KEY-3.name: NOT_A_PURPOSE
KEY-3.description: Raised when a key is asked for with a purpose that is none of the three.

KEY-5.name: NAME_TAKEN
KEY-5.description: Raised when a key is asked for under a name another key holds.

KEY-6.name: NO_SUCH_MEMBER
KEY-6.description: Raised when a member's key names an account the household does not hold.

KEY-8.name: NOT_FOR_YOURSELF
KEY-8.description: Raised when a household member asks for a key, or a revoke, that is not theirs alone.
